senses.gloss:
(इ) णिदि r. 1st cl. (निन्दति-ते प्रणिन्दति) also (ऋ) णिदृ r. 1st cl. (नेदति-ते प्रणेदति)
1 To abuse, to censure, to reproach, to reprove or revile, to despise or condemn, &c. (The second root means also)
2 To approach, to come near. The change of ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives of the first of these roots.
